overloads.semanticRole: Converts a 4D View Pro object (or a specific range within it) to an SVG picture, e.g. for embedding in another document or for printing without loading the area.

constraints: vpObject must have been previously produced by VP Export to object or VP EXPORT DOCUMENT.
SVG conversion requires expressions and formats in the area to have been evaluated at least once beforehand, otherwise they may render unexpectedly.
If rangeObj is omitted, the whole document contents are converted.
Gridline visibility in the exported picture depends on the document's print-info attribute set via VP SET PRINT INFO.
